status: FROZEN V2 CURRENT-REGIME PILOT BEFORE FIRST EXTERNAL LABEL
base_commit_rule: The next registration-only commit will replace null with the first freeze commit that contains these exact input, source, sample and instruction bytes. No sample or analysis field may change in that registration-only commit.

supersedes.status: INVALID BEFORE ANY EXTERNAL OR PILOT LABEL
supersedes.reason: The v1 sampler omitted the production per-document India anchor for Pakistan, China and US Trade and therefore sampled outside the counted numerator.
supersedes.reuse_rule: No v1 row, label or result may be reused, merged or scored.

objective: Estimate matched-item precision within the mechanically selected current production scoring-corpus frame for each of IGRM's five channels under external, blinded application of the frozen rubric; separately describe production-document-instance and normalized-story precision.
study_role: Retrospective current-regime pilot. It exercises and can falsify the audit system; it is not the prospective confirmatory study.
scope_limit: This pilot does not estimate population recall, historical precision, event detection, risk accuracy, causal validity, or precision outside the 11 frozen production-corpus days. It licenses no claim that IGRM is better than CI, AI-GPR or any other index.

inputs.frame_selection_rule: The 11 most recent consecutive complete UTC production score-days ending 2026-08-06, selected mechanically before any label: 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-06 inclusive. No day was selected, removed or extended because of its channel count, score, headline, event status or anticipated label.
inputs.frame_interpretation: Each file is the standard production scoring corpus with 48 sampled Web NGrams snapshots. The frame is the exact matched production document-key set in those sampled corpora, not every article published worldwide on those dates.
inputs.rubric_timing_limit: The frame partly predates the 2026-08-03 rubric lock. That makes this a retrospective current-regime pilot, not a prospective/generalization test.

sample.article_instance_stratum: For each channel, 75 production document keys sampled uniformly without replacement from the exact anchored matched-key frame. A repeated URL under distinct production document keys remains repeated because document instances are the counted unit.
sample.story_cluster_stratum: For each channel, 25 normalized-title clusters sampled independently without replacement from the full frame; one source-key-sorted representative is used per cluster. It may overlap the article-instance stratum and is never pooled with it.
sample.reliability_deduplication_rule: Precision preserves all sampled production instances. Inter-coder reliability counts each exact title-plus-URL evidence identity once and is inconclusive if either coder gives contradictory firm labels to repeated evidence.
sample.pilot_rule: Four unscored items per channel from the separate two-day extended frame, disjoint from all scored rows by URL and normalized title. Coders may discuss only the pilot before independent scoring.

blindness.meaning: Blind to system decisions and sampling stratum, not blind to the target channel or to the fact that this is an IGRM matched-item audit.
blindness.repository_access: External coders must not inspect the IGRM repository or website between opening the scored sheet and locking their completed copy.

evidence_policy.primary: The frozen title in the sheet is immutable evidence captured in the source corpus.
evidence_policy.live_page: A live URL is auxiliary evidence and may drift. A coder records LIVE plus UTC access time, PAYWALL or DEAD whenever consulting it; no unavailable row is replaced.
evidence_policy.copyright: The package does not copy article bodies. Coders inspect ordinary linked pages and quote no article text in the returned sheet beyond a minimal ambiguity note.

labels.ON: Substantively about the named channel under auditor/RUBRIC.md.
labels.OFF: Not substantively about the named channel under auditor/RUBRIC.md.
labels.ABSTAIN: Insufficient accessible evidence for a defensible ruling; always reported and excluded from the precision denominator.
labels.translation: No automated translation. Non-English items without accessible English evidence are ABSTAIN.

estimands.five_primary_pilot_estimates: For each coder and channel separately in the production-document-instance stratum: ON / (ON + OFF), with a Wilson 95% interval. ABSTAIN is excluded from the denominator and always counted. These estimate only the frozen 11-day scoring-corpus frame.
estimands.secondary_story_estimates: The same quantity for each coder and channel in the normalized-title-cluster stratum, labelled descriptive story-level precision.
estimands.secondary_macro: Equal-channel mean of the five article-instance estimates. It is not an overall volume-weighted precision estimate.
estimands.recall: Not estimated. The independent recall protocol uses a different frame and fresh labels.
estimands.hypothesis_tests: None. No p-values, historical extrapolation or multiple-testing-adjusted superiority claim.

quality_gates.per_channel_precision_pass: Pilot diagnostic pass only if at least 60 of 75 article-instance rows receive firm labels and the Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80.
quality_gates.per_channel_inconclusive: Fewer than 60 firm article-instance labels is inconclusive, never a pass.
quality_gates.inter_coder_evaluable_if_two_coders: Evaluate on unique title-plus-URL evidence identities. Require at least 400 firm-overlap identities, no contradictory within-coder firm labels on repeated evidence, and a non-constant pooled firm-label set.
quality_gates.inter_coder_pass_if_evaluable: Raw agreement at least 0.90 and Gwet's AC1 at least 0.70. Cohen's kappa is descriptive only because of prevalence sensitivity.
quality_gates.constant_label_rule: An exactly all-ON or all-OFF unique-evidence overlap is NOT IDENTIFIABLE, not a pass or failure.
quality_gates.one_coder_rule: With one coder, no inter-coder statistic or reliability claim is permitted.
quality_gates.publication: Every channel, abstention count, interval, disagreement, failure and deviation publishes regardless of direction. Payment and publication are not conditional on passing.

coder_independence.minimum: No role in designing IGRM, its dictionaries, sample, rubric or machine auditor; disclose any relationship with the project or founder.
coder_independence.work_rule: After the pilot, coders work independently and do not discuss scored rows until both files are locked.
coder_independence.tool_rule: Coders may use a normal browser for linked evidence but not an LLM, automated classifier, bulk-label tool or another person to decide or draft scored labels.
coder_independence.payment_rule: Fixed compensation agreed before labelling, never contingent on agreement, outcome or pass/fail. Recruitment source, coder count, qualifications and compensation band publish with results.

analysis.primary_rule: With two coders, publish both coder-specific precision results. No consensus or adjudicated primary exists.
analysis.missing_urls: Use frozen title and accessible page evidence or ABSTAIN. Never replace a sampled item.
analysis.deviations: Any source substitution, sample replacement, rubric change after scored work begins, label recoding or adjudication is a dated public deviation before the affected result.

attestation.maintainer_limit: The project maintainer saw some source-day headlines during ordinary operations and found the v1 frame defect. The maintainer is not an eligible external coder and made no v2 label decision.
